The fairness of a particular coin is being investigated
by flipping the coin. Each flip of the coin results in
either a head or a tail. Among the following
experimental results, which one provides the
1 out of 6 flips results in a tail.
1 out of 60,000 flips results in a tail.
60 out of 600 flips result in tails.
60 out of 600,000 flips result in tails.
A certain television show begins at 7:00 p.m. and ends
at 7:30 p.m. Of this time interval, 25% is commercial
time. Each commercial lasts 30 seconds. What is the
total number of commercials included in the show?
